title: Critical Alert Lane
user: An Android user overwhelmed by notifications who needs a tiny offline lane for a few reminders that repeat until explicitly handled.
smallest_useful_product: Android app with an on-device list of recurring critical reminders, repeat-until-acknowledged behavior, configurable quiet hours, and an export/import file.
success_measure: In a 30-day pilot, at least 80% of scheduled critical reminders are acknowledged before their configured escalation window ends.
constraints: Must comply with Android exact-alarm and notification permissions; no contact/calendar permission by default; local encrypted export optional.
